mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index signals deflationary pressures, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 6-month window, or 20-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.2% triggers a monetary tightening cycle, raising policy rates and compressing equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.2%, or the tightening effect fades within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and decrease in UNRATE (unemployment) signals robust economic growth and labor market strength, amplifying corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 2% AND UNRATE down 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the combined signal, or the effect dissipates within 15 days.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% signals potential peak growth, prompting investors to anticipate rate hikes and sell equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive when FEDFUNDS exceed 2.5% in late-cycle periods, or the signal reverses within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.5% indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which depresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 5.5%, or the trend reverses within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in INDPRO below 118 signals supply-side contraction, leading to price spikes and reduced corporate margins, which erodes equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 118, or the contraction reverses within 90 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) by 2% in one month signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 2% AND INDPRO up 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite both proxies rising by 2%, or the effect fades within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary environment, a sustained drop in GDPC1 below 10,000 signals weak demand, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite GDPC1 falling below 10,000 in a recessionary regime, or the signal reverses within 90 days.
